mapper.select: select id, username, password_hash, display_name from sys_user where username = #{username} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select id, username, password_hash, display_name from sys_user where id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select r.code from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by r.sort_order asc, r.id asc

select distinct p.code from sys_permission p inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and rp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by p.code asc
select t.id, t.name from sys_tenant t inner join sys_user_tenant ut on ut.tenant_id = t.id where ut.user_id = #{userId} order by t.sort_order asc, t.id asc
select id, title, name, path, component, icon, permission_code, keep_alive, parent_id, sort_order from sys_menu where menu_scope = #{menuScope} order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_refresh_token ( token, user_id, tenant_id, expires_at, revoked, created_at ) values ( #{token}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{expiresAt}, 0, now() )
mapper.select: select token, user_id, tenant_id, expires_at, revoked from sys_refresh_token where token = #{token} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (id, username, password_hash, display_name, deleted, created_at) values (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select id, code, name from sys_role order by sort_order asc, id asc
select id, code, name from sys_role where id = #{roleId} limit 1
